entries.description: SeekAPI is a China-side procurement desk for overseas buyers and AI agents. Start with the live 2.99 USDC x402 China Supply Check: on success, three evidence-backed China supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ. Then request separately scoped human help for supplier contact, RFQ/quote comparison, samples, procurement and export coordination. Human-task APIs are not live; no supplier contact is included in the check.

nextAction.scope: one confirmed RFQ, up to three selected suppliers, one authorized human outreach round, 72-hour response window; no guaranteed replies

data.proofBoundReads: Status and result require independent signed wallet authentication bound to the settled order; a payment proof alone is not authentication.

input.accepted: text or model/part number, quantity and unit, must-have constraints

output.observedListingPrice: dated currency, original unit/tier/time and source when available; a confirmed reply is a separate step

availabilityEvidence.note: Availability is a timestamped snapshot. Read the live discovery tool before purchase.

data.sampleDisclosure: INTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE: authorized aggregate paid outcome; candidate-level production example not publicly available

chinaSideExecution.intakeBehavior: Browser prepares a user-reviewed email; it does not send or accept a task.
chinaSideExecution.acceptance: Separate scope, fee, recipient permission and authority required before action
